curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: State the belt law for drivers, front-seat and back-seat passengers, and the stricter rule with new drivers.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each belt rule by seat and driver.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on who must be belted.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Match each age and size band to its seat, then explain who is responsible and the penalties.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on rear-facing, forward-facing and booster rules and the fines.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions matching children to seats and drivers to penalties.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain how belts protect, what the manual's figures show, and why the belt myths are wrong.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on belt protection, statistics and myths.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on belt benefits and myths.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show correct belt fit for adults, pregnant women and children, and why child restraints matter.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on belt fit and child restraint benefits.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on belt fit and the belts-to-bones rule.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain how air bags work with belts and where children and adults should sit.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on air bags, child seating and adult distance.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on air bags and seating.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the pickup bed rules, then the dangers and penalties of leaving children in vehicles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on pickup beds, hot cars and child endangerment penalties.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on pickup beds and unattended children.
